claim: The adjectives in [12iv] (the house currently ablaze, all people now alive, the ones asleep) are altogether excluded from attributive position.
evidence_summary: Ch. 6, p. 559: modification or coordination “can greatly improve the acceptability of the attributive use”, with their still awake children and attested an aware, amused glance.
finding: Chapter 5 omits the caveat its cross-reference supplies. Altogether may contrast with the sense difference in [12ii].
proposed_wording: are excluded from attributive position unless expanded by modification or coordination (Ch. 6, §4.2)
inference: Are these adjectives excluded from attributive position in all forms?

evidence.establishes: The two passages differ in modal force.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
